title: Rock made of microscopic shells
text: The oil under this field is held in diatomite, a rock made of the silica skeletons of countless microscopic water plants. It is up to 70 percent empty space, light enough to float on water, and almost impermeable. There are an estimated 2.2 billion barrels of oil in the ground here, and only about five percent of it has come out. The only way to move it is to fracture the rock.

s3.title: Lost Hills Oil Field
s3.quote: According to Chevron's estimate, there are approximately 2.2 billion barrels (350,000,000 m3) of oil in place in the Lost Hills Field, only five percent of which has been extracted.
